book.name: 1 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Machwale gha kutolela
Kwa nhwalo gwa ghala ghunyandike. Mbaha munalome akoto kutolela.
Nambo kwa nhwalo gwa kubhambala ngongola, mbaha kila munalome abhehe na nhwana mundo, na kila mwikeghe abhehe na ungana mundo.
Munalome ahenge ghighapalwa kuhenga kwa nhwana mundo, na jwenio nhwana mundo ahenge ghighapalwa kuhenga kwa ungana mundo.
Nhwana mundo akwete jhe kindendeke panane jha yegha jhake, nambo ungana mundo akwete, helahela na jwenio munalome, akwete jhe kindendeke panane jha yegha jhake, nambo nhwana mundo akwete.

Kila mundo anganyima jhe nnyake, nambo anda nnyiline ntende pandina tugha, kupala nngongela kwa nhwalo gwa kunnyopa Chapanga. Peniya kila mundo amujhile nnyake kabhele, kupala kulibhambala Limbembela kwa nhwalo jha kubhehe gwangakamilika.
Ghanga nilonge nenga, chi malaghalikilo, nipala ntame maha.
Nikapahile bhando bhoha bhabhehe ngita nenga, nambo kila mundo jhumo akwete kitoi chake kuhumii kwa Chapanga, jhumo kitoi chenje na jhonge chela.
Nambo kwa bhala bhangatolela amu bhibhatolile amu mapwela, nenga nilonge naha yamaha kujhendelela kutama uholo ngita nenga.
Nambo anda mundo ahoto jhe kuhimbilila, atolele, amu atolelwe mbaha kutolela amu kutolelwa kuliku kupala ngongola.
Kwa bhala bhubhatolile na bhubhatolilwe napela lilaghalikilo lende, chi lilaghalikilo lyango, nambo ndi lya Bhambo, mwikeghe akoto kunneka ungana mundo.
Nambo anda atei yenio, bhahe atame uholo, amu ajhelane nako ungana mundo. Helahela munalome akoto kunneka nhwana mundo.

Kwa bhando bhange, ne nilonge naha, nambo malobhe ghanga ghahumitii jhe kwa Bhambo. Anda munalome akwete nhwana mundo jwanganyekete Kilichitu, na jwenio nhwana mundo ajheketile kujhendelela kutama na ungana mundo, munalome akotoka kunneka nhwana mundo.
Anda mwikeghe akwete munalome jwanganyeketela Kilichitu, na jwenio ungana mundo ajheketile kujhendelela kutama na nhwana mundo, bhahe, mwikeghe jwenio akotoka kunneka ungana mundo.

Kwa nhwalo munalome jwangannyeketela Kilichitu napokelelwa na Chapanga kwa kulombana na nhwana mundo. Na mwikeghe jhola jwangannyeketela Kilichitu, Chapanga napokelelwa na Chapanga kwa kulombana na ungana mundo. Anda nahijhe yana yabhe ngaibhii ngita yana yangaummanya Chapanga, nambo ngohe chakaka bheniya ndi yana ya Chapanga.

Anda mundo jwannyeketela Kilichitu apala kunneka nnyake jwanyeketela Kilichitu bhahe anneke tugha. Munalome amu mwikeghe jwannyeketela Kilichitu ahibhilikii jhe kutenda yenio. Chapanga atukemite twenga tutame kwa uteeke.
Mwe makeghe jhumujheketii Kilichitu, naumanya bho, anda namunkombola jhe ungana gwino? Amu mwenga manalome jhumujheketile Kilichitu naumanya bho namunkombola jhe nhwana gwino?
Ntame ngita chankemitwe na Chapanga
Kila mundo atame tela na kitoi chapekiwe na Bhambo, na ngita akemitwe na Chapanga. Lyenio ndi lilaghalikio lyango kwa bhando bhubhannyeketii Kilichitu.
Anda mundo akemitwe na Chapanga kongo jwangajhingii jando, bhahe akotoka kukikopokeya ajhingii jhe jando. Anda mundo pakemitwa ajhingii jhe jando, bhahe akotoka kujhingii jando.
Nhwalo kujhingii jando amu changajhingii jando kilebhenacho, kilebhe kikolongwa ndi kukamula lilaghalikilo lya Chapanga.
Bhahe, kila mundo na ahighilike ngita chakibha pakemitwa na Chapanga.
Bho, mwenga pukemitwa na Chapanga mukibha jhe mmanda? Tela, nkotoka kupwelela, nambo anda mpatite pwache nhenge.
Nhwalo jwenio jwakemitwa na Bhambo pakibha mmanda, jwenio jwalekekilwe na Bhambo. Helahela jwakemitwa kongo mmanda jhe, jwenio nabhaha mmanda jwa Kilichitu.
Chapanga aunhemile mangota kwa mbijha jhamahele, nkotoka kubhehe akabhanda bha bhando.
Makalongo bhango, kila mundo ajhendelele kutama na Chapanga, nhwalo Chapanga abhii pamonga na twenga.
Malobhe gha bhando bhangatolela na mapwela
Ngohe kwa malobhe gha bhala bhubhatolile na bhangatolelwa, ngwete jhe lilaghalikio kuhumii kwa Bhambo, nambo nenga nilonge ghanga kwa kiya jha Bhambo nitope kuhobholeka.
Chinilola nenga mang'ahiko ghughahika, mbaha ahighilike ngita chakibha.
Bho, ntolile? Bhahe, mangalogwa jhe kunneka. Bho, ntolii jhe? Mangalogwa jhe kutolela.

Nambo anda ntolile, naibhaha uhengite jhe uhakaho, anda nchikana atolilwe, ahengite jhe uhakaho, nambo bhala bhibhatola chibhapata mang'ahiko ghamahele mu ughome ghongo, na nenga nipala gheniya ghamambale mangota.
Nambo makalongo bhango, mbala kulonge naha, machiko ghahighilike ghandina. Kutumbula ngoheno bhala bhibhatolile na bhatame ngita bhala bhangatolela,
na bhubhalela bhabhehe anda bhangalela, na bhala bhibhaheka bhabhehe ngita bhangahangana. Na bhala bhibhahemela, ilebhe yenio ibhehe ngita yabhe jhe.
Na bhubhabhii mukukakalakana kupalaha ilebhe ya pannema pano bhabha ngita bhando bhangakakalakana. Nhwalo nnema ghongo anda tumanye utenda kupeta.
Nambo mbala mangota ntame changa kiholo. Mundo jwangatolela akakalakana lihengo lya Bhambo, kone ajhigha kunhalalicha Bhambo.
Nambo munalome jwatolile akakalakana mambu gha nnema, anhalaliche nhwana mundo,

ahutilwa na ilebhe ibhele. Mwikeghe jwangatolelwa ukakalakana na mambu gha Bhambo kupala abhehe nyahinyahi yegha na uhuke kwa Bhambo. Nambo jhola jwatolilwe ukakalakana na mambu gha nnema, kwa kunhalalila ungana mundo.
Nilonge naha nipala kuntangatila mangota, nipala jhe kuhibhilikiya kwa chochoha, nambo ntame ngita chiipalwa na kukibhoha mabhene mu mahengo gha Bhambo changahutilwa na mambu ghange.
Anda mundo alola ahenga mbone jhe kuntolela jhe mwikeghe jwannepii inyaghabhule, anda kuhimbilila chepa mbaha atole, anda antolile mwikeghe jwenio ahenga jhe uhakaho.
Anda munalome alola tela kutama changatolela na ahoto kuhimbalila, mmanya kubhehe ahenga mbone kutama changa tolela jwenio nchikana.
Jhola jwapala kutolela mwikeghe ahenga mbone, na jhola jwangatolela ahenga mbone hake.

Mwikeghe jwatolilwe apungitwe na ungana mundo anda abhii ughome. Nambo anda ungana mundo awile, bhahe mwikeghe jwenio ahoto kutolelwa na mwanalome jhonge jwampala, nambo abhehe jwanhobhelela Kilichitu.
Nambo panola nenga, mwikeghe jwenio nabhaha na luhangano hake anda ahighilike changatolelwa. Gheniya nilola nenga pange ngwete Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
